scope: Three authored current API additions; one already translated line retained separately. Outside frozen16244-row denominator. Jeff/Phillip have alpha/update caveats.

records.speaker: Jeff
records.source: [NPC] Jeff: I'm helping a friend complete her Chip collection, could you spare any?
records.translation: [NPC] Jeff: Помогаю подруге собрать коллекцию чипов. Не поделишься?

records.speaker: Jeff
records.source: [NPC] Jeff: Thanks! I'll make sure to give this to her right away.
records.translation: [NPC] Jeff: Спасибо! Обязательно передам ей прямо сейчас.

records.speaker: Ghost of Armorsmith
records.source: [NPC] Ghost of Armorsmith: Thanks! I'm planning on making a Turtle Helmet, and this seemed easier than mass-breeding Turtles on a beach for their scutes.
records.translation: [NPC] Ghost of Armorsmith: Спасибо! Я собираюсь сделать черепаший шлем, и это показалось проще, чем массово разводить черепах на пляже ради щитков.
